purpose: Test whether the ordered pattern of other released airport movements improves direct taxi-time prediction on the exact locally sealed v8 missing-clock gate.
hypothesis: A fixed local event sequence can represent departure queue spacing, runway switches and arrival interference that aggregate movement counts lose. This is an information and representation test, not another target-loss mixture or a new valid-AOBT residual route.

failed_prior_ideas_not_reopened: Historical flight analog worsened the unchanged forward check.
All-airport long-target Huber/classifier mixture worsened the unchanged forward check.
Movement-only application to valid-AOBT rows selected zero weight.

exact_gate.predicate: AOBT_3_flt_missing AND LOBT_flt_missing AND NOT isfinite(cached_proxy) AND airport != 'LIRF'
exact_gate.heldout_scoring: Exact gate AND finite target; include negative and extreme finite target values in score.
exact_gate.ranking: Exact gate over the original 344841-row template, expected 4907 rows; source flags and proxy are never predictors.

event_builder.scope: Released retrospective batch only; construct training and ranking event banks independently with identical code and no labels.
event_builder.query_anchor: The query's released MVT_TIME_UTC_mvt, never its NM off-block time.
event_builder.same_time_peers: Excluded for every query; this also removes any own movement from the time window.
event_builder.self_and_same_flight_exclusion: Exclude exact query MVT_ID. A usable FLIGHT_ID_mvt is a non-null source identity: numeric values must be finite integral values; string values must remain nonempty after trimming and cannot be a null placeholder. Normalize within that source type only, then exclude every peer with the exact same normalized identity as the query. IDs are alignment/filter keys only and are never model channels, embeddings, ordering keys or target encodings. With no usable flight ID, exclude exact movement ID and same-time peers; do not infer identity from callsigns.
event_builder.selection_and_order: Within each airport-month, select the 16 closest strictly earlier and 16 closest strictly later eligible events by absolute UTC time distance. Order the selected past events oldest-to-newest and future events earliest-to-latest. At a peer-time tie, use phase ARR then DEP, trimmed-uppercase runway, then the VALID peer DEP AOBT timestamp; ARR or invalid peer DEP AOBT ties use one canonical missing value. Peers still identical on every channel are interchangeable; never break ties with an opaque ID.
event_builder.runway_normalization: Trim and uppercase. Null, empty and placeholder runway values have relation code -1; exact equality to the normalized query runway has relation code 1, all other valid runways code 0. No fuzzy match or geometry lookup.
event_builder.peer_nm_proxy_rule: For a peer DEP only, use AOBT_3_flt if both timestamps are finite and 0 < peer MVT minus AOBT_3_flt <= 7200 seconds. Peer ARR never supplies an off-block proxy. Invalid peer DEP AOBT never affects event ordering or channels. The query's own NM timestamp is never read into an event channel or neighbor aggregate.

six_float16_channels_in_order.name: peer_nm_aobt_relative_time
six_float16_channels_in_order.encoding: clip((peer_AOBT-query_MVT)/3600,-1,1) for valid peer DEP proxy, else 0

six_float16_channels_in_order.name: peer_nm_aobt_valid
six_float16_channels_in_order.encoding: 1 for valid peer DEP proxy, else 0

six_float16_channels_in_order.name: peer_nm_proxy_interval
six_float16_channels_in_order.encoding: (peer_MVT-peer_AOBT)/7200 for valid peer DEP proxy, else 0

event_builder.padding: Past half is left-padded; future half is right-padded. All six padding values are zero. A separate 32-position boolean event-presence mask, never a seventh event channel, prevents padding from entering masked pooling.
event_builder.missing_query_time_or_airport: All 32 positions padded and mask false; retain the 79 movement fields if available.
event_builder.source_boundary_caveat: The UTC calendar-month partition deliberately withholds adjacent-month events in both 2025 training and the separate 2026 ranking batches. Other missing event history within a released batch remains unobservable.

model.family: One fixed compact masked temporal CNN plus movement tabular branch; direct taxi-time regression.
model.determinism: Set Python, NumPy and PyTorch seeds, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(true), and deterministic CUDA convolution settings before any fit. Record exact runtime, CUDA, device and package versions.
model.movement_input: Exactly the existing 79 movement_only_expert prepared columns in manifest order: 66 numeric and 13 categorical, including its existing flight_name_mvt derived from FLIGHT_mvt. Add no *_flt, own NM timestamp/proxy, opaque ID, raw CALLSIGN_flt or event-channel callsign, own AOBT-time backlog or departure BLOCK/TAXI input.
model.numeric_preprocessing: For each of the 66 numeric movement fields, estimate median and IQR from fit rows only; divide (value-median) by max(IQR,1), clip finite values to [-10,10], and encode missing/nonfinite as -11. Freeze these 66 scalers per fold; heldout and ranking rows cannot update them.
model.categorical_preprocessing: For each of the 13 categorical movement fields, build a fit-row-only vocabulary: observed nonmissing levels sorted by descending fit frequency then UTF-8 lexical order, at most 4096 levels. Index 0 is missing and 1 is unseen/overflow; remaining levels get 2..4097. Each field has an 8-dimensional embedding. Record ordered vocabulary SHA and fit-row IDs. Heldout and ranking levels never expand the vocabulary.
model.event_branch: Convert one float16 disk-backed 32x6 sequence to float32 per streamed batch, split into independent 16-position past and future halves, and apply the same shared-weight Conv1d(6,32,kernel=3,padding=1), GELU, Conv1d(32,32,kernel=3,padding=1), GELU stack to each half. Multiply by its presence mask before and after EVERY convolution so padding/bias never enters a valid convolution neighborhood. Each half gets masked mean and masked max pooling, with zero vectors for an empty half. Concatenate the four 32-vectors and apply Linear(128,64). No convolution crosses the past/future seam between slots 15 and 16.
model.tabular_branch: Concatenate 66 standardized numerics and thirteen 8-dimensional categorical embeddings; Linear(170,128), GELU, Linear(128,64), GELU.
model.head: Concatenate 64 event and 64 tabular outputs; Linear(128,64), GELU, Linear(64,1). No dropout and no auxiliary loss.
model.loss_and_output: Optimize mean squared error of target/3600; multiply the scalar output by 3600 and clip to zero for scored or ranking predictions. Do not cap the upper prediction.
model.early_stop_metric: Unclipped direct-target RMSE on the internal early-stop rows only; ties choose earlier epoch.
model.replacement_formula: On exact v8 gate only, new=clip(v8_old + 1.0*(event_direct-v8_old), lower=0); copy every other old prediction exactly.

training_and_validation.ordinary_training_eligibility: All 2025 DEP rows with finite taxi target in [0,7200] seconds, regardless of own NM availability; own NM fields are masked from all predictors. This exactly matches the old movement-only ordinary-target range.
training_and_validation.fit_and_early_split: For each audit, exclude all held-out UTC months from both fit and internal early stop. For each remaining eligible row, compute absolute Unix-epoch UTC day as floor(MVT_TIME_UTC_mvt to UTC day) divided by 86400 seconds; epoch_day modulo 11 == 0 is internal early stop, and the other eligible rows fit. This reproduces movement_only_expert.fit_movement_model rather than day-of-month modulo 11. Freeze ordered fit/early/held ID SHA and exact label/mask SHA before fitting.
training_and_validation.original_reference: Exact 672428-row sealed v8 composed all-finite OOF policy, joined one-to-one by unique MVT_ID and checked for equal target, UTC MVT time, month, airport and gate. The new model only replaces the exact 4976/2865 finite gate rows in the corresponding fold.
training_and_validation.original_fixed_gate: No blend selection. Weight 1.0 must improve gate RMSE separately in January, July, November and December; improve full-policy all-finite RMSE in each original fold; and give a positive 95-percent paired UTC-day bootstrap lower RMSE-gain bound separately in both folds. Bootstrap 1000 resamples, seed 20261017. Any failure rejects the route with no retuning.
training_and_validation.fresh_april_october: Only after both original folds pass, fit the same architecture excluding April and October from fit and early stop. Compare on exact finite v8 no-NM non-LIRF gate IDs/targets/times against artifacts/v6-movement-only/april_october_predictions.parquet fixed_blend (the saved movement-only weight-1 policy), requiring SHA equality to reports/movement_only_fresh_audit.json prediction_sha256 and its saved movement model/fit metadata before use. April and October each require lower gate RMSE and the pooled paired UTC-day 95-percent lower gain must be positive at seed 20261017/1000. This is a matched component check, not an untouched full-policy estimate.
training_and_validation.reserved_february_august: Only after fresh success, fit the same architecture excluding February and August from fit and early stop. Compare on exact finite gate IDs/targets/times against artifacts/v6-movement-only/february_august_predictions.parquet fixed_blend (the saved movement-only weight-1 policy), requiring SHA equality to reports/movement_only_reserved_audit.json prediction_sha256 and its saved movement model/fit metadata before use. February and August each require lower gate RMSE and the pooled paired UTC-day 95-percent lower gain must be positive at seed 20261017/1000. No weight or model changes follow a failure.
training_and_validation.all_finite_policy_protection: For original folds, compare both gate-only and complete all-finite v8 policies with exact non-gate equality. Fresh/reserved comparisons are component audits because complete independently refitted v8 policies for those months are not claimed.
training_and_validation.heldout_labels: Every finite gate target enters scoring, including negatives and >7200-second extremes excluded from ordinary training; disclose per-month row counts and squared-error concentration without selecting row exceptions.
training_and_validation.repeated_inspection_limitation: January/July, November/December, April/October and February/August 2025 labels have been used in prior research. These fixed gates check component stability, not an untouched generalization or an expected 2026 score.

final_and_ranking.authorization: No full model, ranking values or finalizer until source/spec publication, independent peer review, exact cache/source receipts, both original folds, matched April/October and matched February/August all pass.
final_and_ranking.final_epochs: Integer floor of the median of the two original-fold best epochs only; never use April/October or February/August selected epochs. Reinitialize with seed 20261017 and fit all ordinary eligible 2025 rows for exactly this epoch count, including former internal early-stop rows.
final_and_ranking.final_output: Direct target prediction, clipped at zero, only on the exact ranking v8 gate. Require 4907 gate rows, full 344841 template ID set/order, finite nonnegative predictions and bitwise equality of every other prediction to an explicitly SHA-pinned current valid-route reference whose missing-gate values first match sealed v8.
final_and_ranking.v12_v13_relationship: Current v8 missing-clock policy is unchanged by v9/v12/v13 valid-AOBT replacements. A future valid-route reference may be used only after proving exact equality with v8 on the missing-clock gate and exact outside-gate preservation by this candidate.
final_and_ranking.selected_output: One replacement candidate only; no leaderboard-driven route, row exception, second blend or upload in this spec.

provenance_and_resources.publication_sequence: Publish this spec, then implementation source and peer review, then freeze raw/cache/source/model-reference hashes before any real feature build or label read. Rehash before and after every build, fit, score and ranking operation; all outputs exclusive and immutable.
required_receipts: phase-first source column allowlist and raw file SHA
event cache protocol and byte SHA
fit-only numeric scalers and categorical vocabulary SHA
ordered fit/early/held IDs and labels SHA
saved model SHA and readback prediction SHA
exact baseline/comparator OOF SHA and scored-pair SHA

provenance_and_resources.event_cache_storage_estimate: 2,085,047 training rows x 32 events x 6 float16 channels is 800,658,048 bytes (about 0.75 GiB), plus a separate boolean presence mask and small ranking cache. Store disk-backed in exact baseline ID order and stream batches; do not materialize a dense all-row tensor in RAM.
provenance_and_resources.available_hardware: RTX 3090 with CUDA PyTorch 2.13.0+cu126; current approximately 14.5 GiB free physical RAM. Earlier 4.28 GiB observation was disk free, not host RAM.
provenance_and_resources.source_license: Only organizer-released fields, existing NOAA weather/ARR caches and locally authored code are model inputs. Papers below motivate the event-order hypothesis and are not copied into the code or dataset.

primary_methodological_background.title: A Queuing Model of the Airport Departure Process
primary_methodological_background.relevance: Models unimpeded taxi time and departure runway queueing separately.

primary_methodological_background.title: Improving Departure Taxi Time Predictions Using ASDE-X Surveillance Data
primary_methodological_background.relevance: Identifies runway queue position, cross traffic and nominal taxi versus queue delay as distinct mechanisms; the released events here are weaker proxies than ASDE-X trajectories.

known_limitations: Other flights' AOBT and takeoff times are retrospective source records, not a measured airport-surface trajectory or observed runway queue.
The model's ordinary training labels may not represent the missing-clock gate's extreme or source-corrupted targets.
The gate is small and some very large errors may be unpredictable from released covariates; no magnitude of improvement is assumed.
UTC-month partitioning emulates ranking batch boundaries but cannot recover traffic omitted from the supplied batch.
All local 2025 checks have been repeatedly explored and cannot guarantee a ranking result or prize.
